text:
alex: Ok team — proposing a 6-week micro-pilot with 4 design partners to validate the feedback+observability flow. Goal: surface prompt-level quality regressions and time-to-action. Who's in?
priya: Love it. Suggested success metrics: active DP users >=5/week, feedback completion >=40%, avg time-to-action <48h. Also we need clear recruitment criteria.
maria: +1. For partners let's pick 2 AI-native startups, 1 midmarket SaaS, 1 regulated fintech. Need COIs and legal signoff for data handling.
jon-solutions: I can ping two customers that fit (AcmeAI, LedgerSync). What's the onboarding script look like?
sara-research: I drafted a 6-question micro-survey and 3 lightweight in-app signals. Snippets: `Q1: Was the response useful?`, `Q2: Did output change your decision?`, `Signal: feedback_submitted (true/false)`, `Signal: latency_impact (boolean)`. I'll paste full draft in the doc.
kevin-eng: Engineering asks: analytics events `feedback_submitted`, `feedback_label`, `prompt_hash`; a feature-flagged UI for "feedback mode"; tracing hook to attach model variant. Rough estimate: 2 sprints to ship minimal telemetry + UI toggle.
alex: Scope note — start with non-LTS open models and our hosted infra. Enable KV-cache telemetry (cache_hit/cold) so we can correlate quality with cache state.
priya: Rollout plan proposal: invite -> 1 week onboarding + training -> 4 weeks active feedback -> 1 week wrap & customer interviews. Compensation ideas: $2k hosted credit OR 2-month Dedicated trial.
maria: Acceptance criteria for graduating pilot: consistent signal quality (low noise), at least 3 actionable regressions identified, engineering triage path in place, and no P0 serving regressions caused by pilot.
legal: FYI: legal needs a beta DPA addendum + data handling checklist signed before invites. @maria I'll route templates and a short SOC note.
jon-solutions: I'll assemble outreach deck and the interview script. Draft ready by Tue EOD.
alex: I'll create the JIRA epic and calendar invite. Primary owners: recruitment (jon), survey + interview script (sara/jon), analytics (kevin), ops + partner comms (maria), legal (legal). Next sync Tue 10am PT. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Created epic REDW-1882 for DP feedback micro-pilot and added owners as subtasks. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REDW-1882
kevin-eng: Quick follow-up — we should add a lightweight GUID per prompt to de-dupe user feedback, I can add that to the event schema.
sara-research: Also propose 2 quick validation checkpoints: week 2 mid-check (signal sanity) and week 5 interview synthesis.
alex: Perfect. Thanks all — I'll drop the invite + onboarding checklist in #product-docs.
